node_kinds.name: Duo_Account
node_kinds.description: A Duo tenant identified by its API hostname.

node_kinds.name: Duo_User
node_kinds.description: A Duo end user and their MFA enrollment state.

node_kinds.name: Duo_Admin
node_kinds.description: A Duo administrator. Role and status determine privileges; this node does not imply tenant-wide control.

node_kinds.name: Duo_Group
node_kinds.description: A group of Duo end users that may be permitted to authenticate to applications.

node_kinds.name: Duo_Application
node_kinds.description: An application protected by Duo. Authentication eligibility does not imply control of the application.

node_kinds.name: Duo_Phone
node_kinds.description: A phone registered as an MFA device for one or more end users.

node_kinds.name: Duo_Token
node_kinds.description: A hardware token registered as an MFA factor for one or more end users.

node_kinds.name: Duo_WebAuthnCredential
node_kinds.description: A WebAuthn authenticator registered to a Duo end user.

relationship_kinds.name: Duo_Contains
relationship_kinds.description: The Duo account contains this object. Organizational containment does not grant control of the object.

relationship_kinds.name: Duo_AdminTo
relationship_kinds.description: This administrator belongs to the Duo account. Emitted for every admin role and status, including read-only and disabled admins; it does not establish full account control.

relationship_kinds.name: Duo_MemberOf
relationship_kinds.description: This user is a member of the group and can inherit its application eligibility. Authentication still depends on user status, primary credentials, MFA, and policy.

relationship_kinds.name: Duo_HasAccessTo
relationship_kinds.description: The user or group is permitted by the collected application access configuration. Eligibility to authenticate does not establish application control or successful authentication.

relationship_kinds.name: Duo_HasMFADevice
relationship_kinds.description: This user has the registered MFA device. Control of the user does not establish possession or control of the device or its credentials.
